def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    # Points define vertices/corners of an orthogonal path; connect each aligned pair with 3,
    # except any intervening marker remains 2.
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(pts):
        for r2,c2 in pts[i+1:]:
            if r1==r2 or c1==c2:
                # only connect if no other marker lies between on same line
                dr=(r2>r1)-(r2<r1); dc=(c2>c1)-(c2<c1)
                between=[(r1+dr*k,c1+dc*k) for k in range(1,max(abs(r2-r1),abs(c2-c1)))]
                if not any(grid[r][c]==2 for r,c in between):
                    for r,c in between: out[r][c]=3
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    # The two horizontally aligned outer markers define the crossbar; other markers
    # connect vertically to that row.
    rows={r:[c for rr,c in pts if rr==r] for r,c in pts}
    base=max(rows, key=lambda r: max(rows[r])-min(rows[r]) if len(rows[r])>1 else -1)
    cols=rows[base]
    lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
    for c in range(lo+1,hi):
        if grid[base][c]==0: out[base][c]=3
    for r,c in pts:
        if r==base: continue
        step=1 if base>r else -1
        for rr in range(r+step,base,step):
            if grid[rr][c]==0: out[rr][c]=3
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    # Main spine is the row/column containing the pair of markers with the
    # greatest separation. Fill it between endpoints, then connect each
    # remaining marker perpendicularly to that spine.
    aligned=[]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
            if r==rr or c==cc:
                aligned.append((abs(r-rr)+abs(c-cc),r,c,rr,cc))
    _,r,c,rr,cc=max(aligned)
    if r==rr:
        spine=r
        for x in range(min(c,cc)+1,max(c,cc)):
            if grid[spine][x]==0: out[spine][x]=3
        for pr,pc in pts:
            if pr!=spine:
                step=1 if spine>pr else -1
                for y in range(pr+step,spine,step):
                    if grid[y][pc]==0: out[y][pc]=3
    else:
        spine=c
        for y in range(min(r,rr)+1,max(r,rr)):
            if grid[y][spine]==0: out[y][spine]=3
        for pr,pc in pts:
            if pc!=spine:
                step=1 if spine>pc else -1
                for x in range(pc+step,spine,step):
                    if grid[pr][x]==0: out[pr][x]=3
    return out
